import pandas as pd
path = '/home/beeps/.local/share/idli-bench/codex/formulas_no_cache.q4.codex.1/ws/seva_invoice_register_uncalculated.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='Invoice Register', header=3)
# filter valid invoices
mask = df['Invoice ID'].astype(str).str.startswith('SEVA-')
df2 = df[mask].copy()
# ensure numeric
df2['Quantity'] = pd.to_numeric(df2['Quantity'], errors='coerce')
df2['Unit Rate (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(df2['Unit Rate (INR)'], errors='coerce')
df2['computed'] = df2['Quantity'] * df2['Unit Rate (INR)']
# group by district
group = df2.groupby('District')['computed'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(group.head(10))
print('total rows', len(df2))
PY"
